# Description

Last updated: 03/23/2026 Above belowground comparison; grouping microsite

## load libraries

```{r}

# analysis
library(glmmTMB) # zero inflated data
library(lme4) # mixed-effects models
library(lmerTest) # provide p values for mixed-effect models
library(dplyr) # summarizing and tranform tables
library(DHARMa) # testing for zero inflation
library(tidyr)
library(car)
library(here)

# visualization

library(ggplot2)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(multcompView)


```

## load data

```{r}
# load data
gc <- read.csv(here("5_outputtables", "gc_wcategories.csv"))
```

##clean data

```{r}
#clean data
gc_clean <- gc %>%
  
  #remove double control
  filter(microsite_condition != "double_control") %>% 
  
  mutate(
    # create the Above vs Belowground category
    depth_simple = case_match(surface_depth, 
                              "surface" ~ "aboveground",
                              c("0-5", "5-10", "10-May") ~ "belowground"),
    # set factors and order
    depth_simple = factor(depth_simple, levels = c("aboveground", "belowground")),
    microsite_condition = factor(microsite_condition, 
                                 levels = c("biocrust", "control", "dung")),
    site = as.factor(site))

  # create blank 100 to account for zero counts
all_trays_100 <- expand_grid(
  site = factor(1:20),
  
  # set microsite categorical variables
  combo = c("biocrust_aboveground", "biocrust_belowground",
            "dung_aboveground", "dung_belowground",
            "control_belowground")
) %>%
  separate(combo, into = c("microsite_condition", "depth_simple"), sep = "_") %>%
  mutate(
    depth_simple = factor(depth_simple, levels = c("aboveground", "belowground")),
    microsite_condition = factor(microsite_condition, levels = c("biocrust", "control", "dung"))
  )

```

## Above Below Ground

### Abundance

```{r}
# STEP 1: clean data ----
# do not normalize = normalize abundance by volume 
# aggregate seedling counts by treatment

gc_ab <- gc_clean %>%
  group_by(site, microsite_condition, depth_simple, Species) %>% # columns to keep
  
  #abundance: count
  summarise(total_count = n(), .groups = "drop")

# join gc_ab to blank 100 to get seedling counts
abundance_ab <- all_trays_100 %>%
  left_join(gc_ab, by = c("site", "microsite_condition", "depth_simple")) %>% 
  mutate(
    total_count = replace_na(total_count, 0),
    treatment = paste(microsite_condition, depth_simple, sep = "_")
  )
         

# STEP 2: run glmm-----
#attempt 1: failed assumptions : glmer-----
#model_abundance <- glmer(seedpercm3 ~ microsite_condition * surface_depth + (1 | site), 
#data = tray_normal)

#anova(model_abundance) # anova table
#attempt 2: glmmTMB-----this model meets all assumptions----
model_abundance_ab <- glmmTMB(total_count ~ treatment +
                               (1|site), 
                               data = abundance_ab,
                               family = poisson())

Anova(model_abundance_ab, type = "III") # is this line of code okay? random effect model

# STEP 3: test assumptions ----
# check normality = right skewed
hist(abundance_ab$total_count)

#tweedie model passed all assumptions
simulationOutput_120 <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = model_abundance_ab)

#dispersion test significant with glmmTB
plot(simulationOutput_120) 
testOutliers(simulationOutput_120) # nonsig
testDispersion(simulationOutput_120)
```

## graph

```{r}

# Get letters from the model
emm_counts_ab <- emmeans(model_abundance_ab, ~ treatment, type = "response")
emm_letters_ab <- as.data.frame(cld(emm_counts_ab, Letters = letters, adjust = "tukey")) %>%
  mutate(.group = trimws(.group)) %>%
  # Split "biocrust_aboveground" into two columns for plotting
  separate(treatment, into = c("microsite_condition", "depth_simple"), sep = "_") %>%
  mutate(
    depth_simple = factor(depth_simple, levels = c("aboveground", "belowground")),
    microsite_condition = factor(microsite_condition, levels = c("biocrust", "control", "dung"))
  )

# label positions (so letters sit above each box)
letter_pos_ab <- abundance_ab %>%
  group_by(microsite_condition, depth_simple) %>%
  summarise(y_pos = max(total_count, na.rm = TRUE) + 2, .groups = "drop") 

# join letters to their specific positions
emm_letters_ab <- left_join(emm_letters_ab, letter_pos_ab, by = c("microsite_condition", "depth_simple"))

# ggplot  
ggplot(abundance_ab, aes(x = microsite_condition, y = total_count, fill = microsite_condition)) +
  # whiskers
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", width = 0.25) +
  
  # boxplot
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 21, width = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) +
  
  # significance letters (using the joined y_pos)
  geom_text(data = emm_letters_ab, 
            aes(x = microsite_condition, y = y_pos, label = .group),
            size = 5, vjust = 0) +
  
  # faceting
  facet_wrap(~ depth_simple, nrow = 1,
             labeller = labeller(depth_simple = c("aboveground" = "Aboveground (Surface)", 
                                                  "belowground" = "Belowground (0-10 cm)"))) +
  
  # professional colors
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("biocrust" = "#8B9E6B", 
                               "dung" = "#C4944A", 
                               "control" = "#D4C09A"),
                    labels = c("Biocrust", "Control", "Dung")) +
  
  # labels and theme
  labs(x = NULL, 
       y = "Seedling Count (per tray)", 
       fill = "Microsite") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),   
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    text = element_text(size = 12)
  )
```

### Richness

```{r}
# clean data and create species count
richness_counts_ab <- gc_clean %>%
  group_by(site, microsite_condition, depth_simple) %>%
  summarise(
    richness = n_distinct(Species), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# join with master list to include empty trays ----
tray_richness_ab <- all_trays_120 %>%
  left_join(richness_counts_ab, by = c("site", "microsite_condition", "depth_simple")) %>%
  mutate(
    tray = row_number(),
    richness = replace_na(richness, 0)
  )

# STEP 3: run glmmTMB for R]richness ----
# Richness is count data -> poisson + zero Inflation is standard
model_richness_120 <- glmmTMB(richness ~ microsite_condition * depth_simple +
                              (1|site), 
                              data = tray_richness_ab,
                              ziformula = ~1, 
                              family = poisson)

Anova(model_richness_120, type = "III")

# STEP 4: test assumptions ----
sim_richness_120 <- simulateResiduals(model_richness_120)
plot(sim_richness_120)
```

### Evenness

```{r}

# calculate shannon h for pielou’s j (evenness) ----
evenness_ab <- gc_clean %>%
  # Count each species per microsite/depth combination
  group_by(site, microsite_condition, depth_simple, Species) %>%
  summarise(sp_count = n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  # Calculate proportions based on the NEW collapsed totals
  mutate(
    p_i = sp_count / sum(sp_count),
    ln_p_i = p_i * log(p_i)
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    shannon_h = -sum(ln_p_i),
    richness_val = n(), 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    evenness = if_else(richness_val > 1, shannon_h / log(richness_val), 0)
  )

# STEP 2: join with master list to include empty trays ----
tray_evenness_ab <- all_trays_120 %>%
  left_join(evenness_ab, by = c("site", "microsite_condition", "depth_simple")) %>%
  mutate(
    tray = row_number(),
    # Beta family cannot handle exactly 0 or 1
    evenness_raw = case_when(
      evenness <= 0 ~ 0.001,
      evenness >= 1 ~ 0.999,
      TRUE ~ evenness
    )
  )

# STEP 3: run glmmTMB for evenness ----
model_evenness_ab <- glmmTMB(evenness_raw ~ microsite_condition * depth_simple +
                               (1|site), 
                              dispformula = ~microsite_condition, 
                              data = tray_evenness_ab,
                              family = beta_family())

Anova(model_evenness_ab, type = "II")

# STEP 4: check assumptions -------
sim_evenness_ab <- simulateResiduals(model_evenness_ab)
plot(sim_evenness_ab) # residuals are significant
```

# Microsite

```{r}
# no groups; use raw data frame: gc_clean

# summarize tray level data
ms <- gc %>%
  group_by(site, microsite_condition) %>%
  summarise(
    total_seedlings = n(), 
    species_richness = n_distinct(Species), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# STEP 2: Create a 60-row Master List
all_microsites <- expand_grid(
  site = factor(1:20),
  microsite_condition = c("biocrust", "dung", "control")
)

df_60 <- all_microsites %>%
  left_join(ms, by = c("site", "microsite_condition")) %>%
  mutate(
    total_seedlings = replace_na(total_seedlings, 0),
    species_richness = replace_na(species_richness, 0)
  )


```

```{r}

ms_aov <- glmer(total_seedlings ~ microsite_condition +
                (1|site), 
                data = df_60,
                family = poisson()) # for zero-inflated data
                
summary(ms_aov)

  
```

##graph

```{r}
ggplot(df_60, aes(x = microsite_condition, y = total_seedlings, fill = microsite_condition)) +
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("biocrust" = "#8B9E6B", "dung" = "#C4944A", "control" = "#D4C09A")) +
  labs(y = "Total Seedlings (all depths combined)", x = "Microsite") +
  theme_classic()
```
